correctness.rationale: On the 9-vertex K3 square K3 graph, the 45 disconnected induced four-sets yield the dual full 2-skeleton and exact f-vector (1,9,36,84,81,36,6). A stand-alone exhaustive verifier checks 69 legal collapses to a 3D complex (1,9,36,51,18). Signed integral boundary matrices have Smith ranks (8,28,17), every nonzero invariant factor 1 and zero residual matrix, hence H2=Z^6 and H3=Z. Simply connected 2-skeleton and primitive 3-cell attachments give a wedge of six 2-spheres and one 3-sphere. Nine-vertex Alexander duality then gives ordinary cut H3=Z,H4=Z^6. Independent cut-side mod-two rank check (8,28,50,39) agrees.

value.rationale: The natural smallest square rook graph beyond clique-prism factors is an unclassified k=4 base case between a known all-parameter k=3 rook theorem and a k=4 calculation at 4x4. The new exact integral homotopy type of its Alexander dual reveals a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge, and the original pure complex has nonzero next-to-top homology and is nonshellable. This is a motivated, complete finite classification, not a generic enumeration slice or inference from an already-covered stronger theorem.
